name: Karang Amakkar
summary: At Zoram'gar Outpost, Karang Amakkar watches the rocky coast as threats close in around the Horde.

sections.title: On the Coast of Ashenvale
sections.body: At Zoram'gar Outpost on the Zoram Strand, Karang Amakkar guards one of the Horde's most exposed borders. The camp faces danger from the sea, the night elves, and wild beasts inland. Along the road east, Karang watches hostile peoples and guards Horde couriers and scouts from ambush by tribes defending their territory.

sections.title: Dealing with the Furbolgs
sections.body: Karang Amakkar gives much of his attention to the furbolgs of the ancient woods, especially the Foulweald tribe. Corruption and primal hostility drive these bear-folk into frenzies. So Karang sends capable warriors to bring down their leader and clear their dens before the tribes can gather for an organized assault on Zoram'gar.

faq.answer: Karang Amakkar is an orc scout at Zoram'gar Outpost on Ashenvale's coast. He watches regional threats for the Horde, especially hostile furbolg clans.

faq.q: Where can I find Karang Amakkar?
faq.answer: You can find Karang Amakkar at Zoram'gar Outpost on Ashenvale's northwestern shore, along the Zoram Strand.

faq.q: What tasks does Karang Amakkar offer?
faq.answer: Karang sends Horde adventurers against nearby furbolg tribes and directs a strike against the king of the Foulweald.

faq.q: Why is Karang worried about the furbolgs?
faq.answer: Ashenvale's furbolgs have grown savage and corrupt. They attack travelers and threaten to cut Zoram'gar Outpost off from the Horde's other strongholds in the region.

faq.q: Is Karang Amakkar related to Initiate Amakkar?
faq.answer: Karang Amakkar and Initiate Amakkar share a clan name or family surname, but their exact family relationship is unconfirmed.

faq.q: Does Karang fight the night elves directly?
faq.answer: Karang Amakkar's duties at Zoram'gar focus on defending the territory and confronting wild threats such as the Foulweald furbolgs. Other Horde commanders handle direct military action against the night elves.

angles.text: As a Horde traveler in western Ashenvale, you can rely on Karang Amakkar to send you against hostile creatures around Zoram'gar Outpost.
Far from Durotar, Karang Amakkar holds a remote outpost. His post shows the grit of orc sentries guarding dangerous borders.
